name: aleph-zero
description: Local code search for coding agents: ranked code locations by meaning or by name, always matching the working tree, and steering that makes Claude Code use it before recursive grep

rung.title: Steering rung
rung.description: How far the plugin steers Claude Code towards Aleph's search. 0: the tools only. 1 (default): the search tools loaded up front, a short instruction to search before a recursive grep, and a pointer in Grep's and Glob's descriptions. 2: also ranked locations with the first question of a session. 3: also ranked locations after a Grep tool search or a recursive grep that found nothing.

grep_pointer.title: Pointer in Grep and Glob
grep_pointer.description: on or off (default on): whether the descriptions of Grep and Glob point to Aleph's search (part of rung 1).

lines.title: Rung 2's lines
lines.description: places or signatures (default places): what rung 2 shows for each file, its places only, or also the signature of its first result.

graph.title: Call graph, facts and decision tools
graph.description: on or off (default off). On: also offer the agent the engine's call-graph (who calls what), facts (routes, models, environment names) and decision-record tools. Off until measured to help an agent.
